title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Check records for uncommitted changes (Added the IsDirty property to the Record API)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces the IsDirty property to the Record API, allowing developers to check whether a record instance has uncommitted changes before performing validation or saving operations. This feature is available in runtime version 18.0 and later.
key_points: The IsDirty property returns a boolean indicating whether an in-memory record has different values than its database state
Developers can use IsDirty to determine if a record has been modified since retrieval or last persistence
The feature requires runtime version 18.0 or greater and is not available in version 17.0
This enables conditional logic for validation, saving, and processing based on actual changes

quotes.text: Use the Record API IsDirty property to determine whether a record instance contains unsaved changes before deciding to validate, save, or otherwise process it.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the primary purpose and use case for the new feature

quotes.text: Gets a boolean value that indicates whether the current in-memory record instance has different values than when it was loaded from the database.
quotes.why_it_matters: This clarifies the exact behavior and return value of the IsDirty method
